title: FabTwin case-run manifest
description: Machine-readable result-traceability record for one case-study run, per Overview section 3.3. Written by `make cases` into cases/<case-name>/manifest.json — never hand-edited. Locked at P0 ahead of Gate T4 (when cases first land) so the evidence pipeline is proven with a hand-written fixture before any real case exists — see tests/unit/test_case_manifest_schema.py.

config_hash.description: hash of the frozen configs/cases/<case-name>.* input this run was generated from

random_seed.description: canonical single-seed demo run: the seed. multi-seed summary run: null, with seeds_summary populated instead.

seeds_summary.description: required once a case reports resume/report-citable numbers (Overview section 4.4: >=30 seeds)

kpis.description: case-specific key results (e.g. detection_delay_median, false_alarm_count, cpk, wafer_yield) - shape varies by case_name and is not fixed at schema level
